name: Artifactory
notes: Hackerspace (Perth, AU); activity active; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Homepage states: 'Slack is our online community platform where members and non-members alike chat and socialise' with signup at perart.io/slack (vanity redirect, presumably to a Slack invite). No other public chat link found.

name: RLab - Reading Hackspace
notes: Hackerspace (Reading, GB); activity active; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Google Group 'reading-hackspace' linked from homepage. Site also mentions a private 'Member's Discord' for tool inductions but no public invite link was given. Site has active Meetup/Bluesky presence, seems active.

name: Liege Hackerspace
notes: Hackerspace (Liège, BE); activity active; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Homepage links to a RocketChat instance at chat.lghs.be (not in the requested platform list but functionally a public group-chat portal comparable to Mattermost). Could not verify open self-signup (WebFetch blocked on that subdomain). Site shows regular Wednesday open hours and active Mastodon/GitHub, appears active.

name: VarnaLab
notes: Hackerspace (Varna, BG); activity unclear; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Google Group at groups.google.com/g/varnalab is the recommended channel per the contacts page (used for their monthly newsletter). A Slack at https://slack.varnalab.org also exists but the page explicitly states in Bulgarian that Slack is 'NOT actively used' (НЕ СЕ ИЗПОЛЗВА АКТИВНО), so the mailing list is the better public-active channel; activity level of the space itself is unclear from what was fetched.

name: Cheltenham Hackspace
notes: Hackerspace (Cheltenham, GB); activity active; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Wiki 'Communication' page (linked from the main site's GitHub link) lists Discord as their primary public channel for non-member questions; also has a members-only WhatsApp group and uses GitHub Issues as an informal forum.

name: Hackfest
notes: Hackerspace (Quebec, CA); activity active; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Discord link appears in both the header nav (labeled 'AUJOURD'HUI') and footer social icons on the homepage.

name: L'abscisse
notes: Hackerspace (Dijon, FR); activity unclear; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Site text says 'sur IRC (#coagul sur oftc)' in the context of arranging carpooling to meetings; page also mentions the domain irc.coagul.org. Content read as fairly dated/community-org style (carpooling coordination), so recent activity is not confirmed from this page alone.

name: FizzPOP
notes: Hackerspace (Birmingham, GB); activity active; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Google Group 'birmingham-hack-space' listed on the fizzPOP homepage alongside Facebook/Twitter/Meetup. Site shows recent posts (Forge & Blacksmithing, June 2026) and weekly Wednesday open evenings, so the space looks active.

name: Eigenbaukombinat Halle
notes: Hackerspace (Halle, DE); activity active; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Matrix room #sozialraum:matrix.eigenbaukombinat.de described as the main chat, 'all new users are automatically added'. Site shows events through March 2026, blog posts Jan-Mar 2026 — clearly active.

name: Boring Place
notes: Hackerspace (Saratov, RU); activity unclear; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Homepage says announcements go out via the sarlug mailing list ('Линуксовка, по традиции, объявляется в рассылке') at lists.lug.ru/mailman/listinfo/sarlug. Page references biweekly Sunday meetups but no dated posts were visible to confirm current-year activity.

name: Stockholm Makerspace
notes: Hackerspace (Stockholm, SE); activity active; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Wiki page explicitly gives this shared-invite link to join Slack ('For att gå med kan man gå till följande länk'). Site has active calendar, member portal, and 2024-2025 dated content.

name: VHS
notes: Hackerspace (Vancouver, CA); activity active; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Discourse-powered community forum, footer says 'Powered by Discourse'; has a 'Newcomers Lounge' and 'Tour Requests' category suggesting active use, but couldn't confirm signup is fully open (no explicit policy statement seen).

name: Chaos Computer Club
notes: Hackerspace (Hamburg, DE); activity active; link found by the hackerspace link hunt. Batch entry listed website as ccc.de (national site) but city=Hamburg maps to the CCC Hamburg local chapter site hamburg.ccc.de, which lists a Matrix chat room #ccchh:hamburg.ccc.de and a Matrix 'space' #ccchh-space:hamburg.ccc.de, plus a Mailman mailing list at https://lists.hamburg.ccc.de/postorius/lists/talk.lists.hamburg.ccc.de/. Also active on Fediverse @ccchh@chaos.social.
